mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom kitchen cabinets are built to exact specifications, offering unlimited design flexibility in terms of size, shape, material, and finish, making them ideal for unique or challenging kitchen layouts. Semi-custom cabinets offer more options than stock cabinets but are manufactured in standard sizes with pre-defined modifications. The primary tradeoff involves cost and lead time; custom cabinets are typically more expensive and take longer to produce but provide a truly bespoke solution, whereas semi-custom options offer a balance of personalization and affordability with shorter lead times. This decision often depends on your budget and desired level of customization for your home in areas like Dublin.
